attributes.name: Pot Helm
attributes.powers:
If proficient with weapons, bury this card to add 1d4 to a combat check by a character at your location.

Bury this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you to 0.

After you play this card, if you have the Goblin trait and are proficient with light armors, you may discard this card instead of burying it.
